vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: certcheck
Version: 4.0.1

The certcheck skill is a static documentation reference tool. The primary script (scripts/script.sh) uses heredocs to output generic information regarding security patterns and best practices, with no evidence of network access, file system manipulation, or sensitive data exfiltration. The SKILL.md instructions are consistent with the code's behavior and do not contain any prompt injection or malicious directives.

llm.summary: This is a local reference/help skill that prints static documentation; it doesn't request credentials, call external services, or install software.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Certcheck reference) align with the included assets: an instruction SKILL.md and a shell script that emit static documentation. Nothing in the manifest asks for unrelated credentials or tools.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md states all commands output plain-text via heredoc with no network calls; the bundled scripts/script.sh implements those commands and only prints docs. Minor editorial mismatches: metadata version is 4.0.1 while the script VERSION is 4.0.0, the help text prints 'certcheck v$VERSION' inside a single-quoted heredoc so $VERSION will not expand (appears literal), and the cheatsheet references a 'troubleshooting' entry that isn't implemented as a command. These are quality issues but not security concerns.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only with a script). No downloads or archive extraction. Lowest-risk installation footprint: nothing is written to disk by an installer beyond the included files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, credentials, or config paths are declared or used. The runtime script does not read env vars or sensitive paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and standard user-invocable/autonomous defaults are used. The skill does not request persistent privileges, nor does it modify other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only prints static reference documentation locally and does not use network access or credentials. Before installing or running: (1) review the script if you want to be extra cautious — it's short and human-readable; (2) be aware of minor non-security issues (version string mismatch and a cheatsheet entry referenced but not implemented); (3) run it in a limited environment if you're concerned, since it is a shell script. No red flags requiring blocking were found.
